biography.plain_text: Tony James Todd founded Micheldever Tyre & Auto Services. A qualified marine engineer from Torquay, he started the Hampshire business in 1972 with car repairs and sales, then built it into a national tyre wholesaler and retail network. Todd sold the company to a management team backed by Graphite Capital and RBS in 2006.

long_biography.plain_text:
When fire destroyed Micheldever’s original premises in 1983, Todd converted a storage building at Sutton Scotney into a temporary base. A purpose-built replacement followed two years later. The recovery became a platform for broader services: tyres for cars, motorcycles and off-road vehicles, along with exhaust, brake and suspension work. Mobile fitting arrived at the turn of the millennium.

Todd had entered business after training as a marine engineer in Torquay. Over three decades, the local operation he created evolved into a substantial wholesaler, distributor and retailer serving customers across Britain. His tenure ended with a management buyout financed by Graphite Capital and Royal Bank of Scotland, completing the transition from founder-led enterprise to a professionally managed national group.

uncertainties.detail: Tony is established as Anthony James Todd through the conjunction of the exact middle name, matching British nationality, Companies House's November 1947 birth date, source age 72 in May 2020, Protyre-company directorships and the matching February 2006 exit. No private-asset evidence is used.

A British investment executive also named Anthony James Todd was born in July 1960 and is therefore incompatible with the source age; he and his Aspect Capital biography were excluded. The American actor Tony Todd likewise has different nationality, dates and profession.

Companies House provides only November 1947, so birth month and year are proposed while birth day and place remain blank. Torquay is described as the place associated with Todd's marine-engineering background, not necessarily his birthplace.

The public record clearly documents the 2006 sale but does not rank Todd's present principal investments. Automotive is used for primary industry solely as the schema's disclosed origin-sector fallback; it does not imply continuing ownership of Micheldever.

The founder-built mechanism supports Self-made. Available strong sources do not describe Todd's family wealth, launch capital or inheritance history well enough to choose either independent-start or advantaged-start.

A sparse Tony Todd LinkedIn profile naming Horatio Properties was not authenticated by a personal domain, exact birth detail or two strong independent exact-person links; it is withheld. Other platform results belong to obvious namesakes.

Automotive distribution is the single minimum useful taxonomy tag because Todd's thirty-four-year founder role directly built a tyre wholesale, distribution and retail enterprise. Generic entrepreneurship, wealth, marine engineering and lifestyle tags are not proposed.

Both biographies exclude private assets, residences, travel, lifestyle, rankings, changing valuations and unverified post-sale activity. The 2006 sale is retained as a durable public business milestone without a transaction-price claim.
